#!/bin/bash

    sleep 30

  --data_path data/human/eval_holdout.jsonl \
  --output_path output/eval_diagnostic_contamination0.json

echo "Eval done!"
cat output/eval_diagnostic_contamination0.json
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/auto_eval_diag.sh
